10277|a14963d0.name: Groum Stonebeard
10277|a14963d0.text: Ye've got a little skill on ye. Enough to learn ye a few things I wager. Let's see what I can teach ye, shall we?

11028|ea44f66d.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|ea44f66d.text: I heard the new Henweigh 6000 will be rolling off the assembly line soon. I can barely contain my excitement!

12042|a2527c6f.name: Loganaar
12042|a2527c6f.text:
Welcome, my brother.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

1232|2583dfa7.name: Azar Stronghammer
1232|2583dfa7.text: The Light be with ya, $c. How can I help ya?

1241|4a926ca6.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|4a926ca6.text: Good day to ye lad. Can I be of service?

1241|91b167bf.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|91b167bf.text: Here for training eh? Just began my training meself, but I would be glad ta teach ye what I can.

1247|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1252|83b3b21e.name: Senir Whitebeard
1252|83b3b21e.text: Greetings and salutations to you, good $r. P'rhaps you'd like to share a drink with me, help fight off the chill of the wind? Come, I've more than enough to share.

1253|a23f7e7e.name: Father Gavin
1253|a23f7e7e.text: Welcome, $c, to the Misty Pine. If you are weary from your travels, feel free to rest and warm yourself inside. And perhaps if you've some spare time, you could assist me in some tasks.

1265|a0959aba.name: Rudra Amberstill
1265|a0959aba.text: Welcome to the Amberstill Corral.  If you're interested in purchasing a mount, my husband Veron will be more than happy to help you choose just the right beast.  If you're looking for adventure, well we sure could use some help around here. . .

1340|76d04af9.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|76d04af9.text:
Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!

Thelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.

1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

1374|61386298.name: Rejold Barleybrew
1374|61386298.text:
Curse that Brewers' League!  They have access to all the best ingredients, while we're stuck here grubbing for grain and hops!

I really would like to give them some bitter tasting justice...

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1470|28fe9799.name: Ghak Healtouch
1470|28fe9799.text: Did my sweet lass Kali send you down to me? The apple of my eye, she is.

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1681|d4740e3c.name: Brock Stoneseeker
1681|d4740e3c.text: The best miner has a firm grip on his pick, a stout heart in his chest, and thick, black dust in his hair.

1699|0c543544.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1699|b48f927f.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

1702|263b99e7.name: Bronk Guzzlegear
1702|263b99e7.text: Just a minor adjustment here... ah there we go!

2326|a28d29e1.name: Thamner Pol
2326|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

241|2823b3ed.name: Remy "Two Times"
241|2823b3ed.text: Hey there, friend.  My name's Remy.  I'm from Redridge to the east, and came here looking for business, looking for business.  You got any...got any??

258043|c6710551.name: Norric Lochthane
258043|c6710551.text: Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.

264936|6ba63b30.name: Earthseer Farsen
264936|6ba63b30.text: On a clear day, you can even see Blackrock Mountain from here. It's both beautiful and terrifying at the same time.

271546|7dbe534f.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
271546|7dbe534f.text:
Lookin' fer the courier? Just flew off like a wee bird.

Can't say I blame the poor sod. These wendigos are nasty business.

2786|c9907ea0.name: Gerrig Bonegrip
2786|c9907ea0.text:
Welcome to Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, $c.  You may look, but do not touch.

Some of the knowledge here is not meant for the...uninitiated.

3518|ed056522.name: Thomas Miller
3518|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

4256|d1bed30c.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
4256|d1bed30c.text: If you ask me, there's no greater profession than a miner.  And if you ask me, there's no greater miner than a $r!

460|86b6c1ef.name: Alamar Grimm
460|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5111|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Firebrew
5111|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

5147|2583dfa7.name: Valgar Highforge
5147|2583dfa7.text: The Light be with ya, $c. How can I help ya?

5149|837f02f9.name: Brandur Ironhammer
5149|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

5491|08830bac.name: Arthur the Faithful
5491|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

5491|837f02f9.name: Arthur the Faithful
5491|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

6179|bb05f662.name: Tiza Battleforge
6179|bb05f662.text: Many tests await a $c of the Light, KAHZ. Be assured, our paths will cross many times in the future if you remain passionate and hold to those virtues that we praise.

714|7dd450ba.name: Talin Keeneye
714|7dd450ba.text: Greetings, $c! Fine day for hunting, wouldn't you say? I've been having more than a little luck with boars, myself. Perhaps you'd like a shot?

7232|2ebb471e.name: Borgus Steelhand
7232|2ebb471e.text: What are ye daft? That's not a weapon, that's a dinner knife. I don't train amateurs.

786|b76e4f1a.name: Grelin Whitebeard
786|b76e4f1a.text: Greetings, lad. I'm Grelin Whitebeard. I'm here to examine the threat posed by the growing numbers of trolls in Coldridge Valley. What have I found? It's a bit troubling...

836|b62f5856.name: Durnan Furcutter
836|b62f5856.text: I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!

8508|15b608c8.name: Gretta Ganter
8508|15b608c8.text: Lookin' to fish? Then you'll need the proper tools.

895|a665cdb8.name: Thorgas Grimson
895|a665cdb8.text: Wot kin I do fer ye?

9099|07b284ab.name: Sraaz
9099|07b284ab.text: This cherry pie tastes so good, it could make a grown gnome cry.

9099|2b8e5d50.name: Sraaz
9099|2b8e5d50.text: Fresh cherry pie for sale, looks so good it will bring a tear to your eye.

9099|e8063847.name: Sraaz
9099|e8063847.text: Cherry pie is my favoritist food in all of Azeroth.

926|2583dfa7.name: Bromos Grummner
926|2583dfa7.text: The Light be with ya, $c. How can I help ya?

957|8622dd6f.name: Dane Lindgren
957|8622dd6f.text: You're not bad, but let me show you a few tricks you might find handy.

102-accept.name: Captain Danuvin
102-accept.text:
Stormwind has abandoned us.  A foul wind of depravity rustles through the plains of Westfall.  This was my homeland and I will not turn my back on the citizens who choose to remain here.  We, the former farmers, shall make our stand.

Your task, should you choose to accept, is to patrol the grasslands of Westfall.  Track down and slay the vile Gnolls that seem to be working in conjunction with the Deadmines thieves. Bring me eight Gnoll Paws and I will reward your bravery.
102-accept.title: Patrolling Westfall

102-complete.name: Captain Danuvin
102-complete.text: Well done, $N.  With valiant adventurers such as yourself fighting alongside The People's Militia, Westfall just might return to the prosperous breadbasket it once was.  Please accept this in recognition of your tireless efforts.
102-complete.title: Patrolling Westfall

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

109-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
109-accept.text: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, $c.  If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle.  He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall.  I bet he could use your help.  You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
109-accept.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

109-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
109-complete.text:
Ah, so my friend sent you here?  How kind.  

Well the Stormwind Monarchy has abandoned our cause.  Now it is up to the People's Militia to keep the land free from corruption.  If our cause interests you, I can put your combat skills to use in the name of freedom.
109-complete.title: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle

12-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-accept.text:
The People's Militia has but one goal:  To defend the lands of Westfall and return peace to our surroundings.  Unfortunately, the price of peace is often blood. 

One of my scouts has brought word of a band of Defias Trappers wreaking havoc nearby.  I have reports of Defias Trapper sightings near the Jangolode Mine to the Northwest as well as at the Molsen Farm and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. If you seek to join our ranks, slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me.
12-accept.title: The People's Militia

12-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-complete.text: Well done, $N.  My scout witnessed your valiant acts.  You are proving yourself quite well so far.
12-complete.title: The People's Militia

13-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-accept.text:
A band of vicious Defias Pillagers has been seen plundering the Gold Coast Quarry, Moonbrook and the Alexston Farmstead.  The People's Militia will not stand for such behavior.  Dispatch immediately, $N, and make the Light's presence known in Westfall.

The Gold Coast Quarry is near the shore, to the West of the tower.  As the next step of your training, I want you to kill 15 of those foul Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters.
13-accept.title: The People's Militia

1338-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1338-accept.text:
There is a dwarven armorsmith whose work I admire greatly.  His name is Furen Longbeard, and his skill is unmatched.  I need a new shield, and I must have one of his!

The problem is... Furen is far to the south, in the dwarven district within Stormwind.  In human lands!  I can't imagine why he would live there, so far from Ironforge.  The humans must pay him a king's ransom to keep him there!

So, if you want to travel and don't mind making some money, then will you send Furen my request for a shield?
1338-accept.title: Stormpike's Order

1338-complete.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-complete.text:
Ah, a request from one of the Stormpikes.  That's a proud clan, full of quality dwarves.  Rich ones, too.

Thank you, $N.  I'll get to work on Mountaineer Stormpike's shield by the end of the day.
1338-complete.title: Stormpike's Order

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

1339-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1339-accept.text:
I hear Mountaineer Stormpike is looking for a runner.  Someone to do a little traveling for him.  How about it?  Are you the $r for the job?

If so, then you'll find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower.
1339-accept.title: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task

1339-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1339-complete.text:
That's right.  I have a task that I can't do while I'm guarding.  In fact, it'll take you far from Loch Modan.

Your perfect chance for adventure!
1339-complete.title: Mountaineer Stormpike's Task

151-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-accept.text:
Poor Old Blanchy!  Such a tired beast after all the work we put her through. I fed her before we left the farm, but we weren't expecting the wagon to break on us. If you could bring her a few handfuls of oats from the fields, I'd be grateful.

I bet you could find some around all of the farms in Westfall, if you can steer clear of those horrific machines that have taken over. There are several farms southwest of here.
151-accept.title: Poor Old Blanchy

151-complete.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-complete.text: Thank you so much, $N!  Poor Old Blanchy will be so happy!
151-complete.title: Poor Old Blanchy

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-accept.name: Scout Galiaan
153-accept.text:
The Defias Front is constantly shifting.  I've been following their movements for quite some time now.  On a side note, I've ascertained that many members of the gang can be tracked by the Red Leather Bandanas they wear.

Bring me 15 of these Bandanas and I'll see to it you are rewarded.
153-accept.title: Red Leather Bandanas

153-complete.name: Scout Galiaan
153-complete.text: Nice work, $r.  Please accept one of these items as payment for all your hard work.
153-complete.title: Red Leather Bandanas

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

1599-accept.name: Alamar Grimm
1599-accept.text:
You must be the new $c everyone's been whispering about. Must be someone's taken a liking to you if they've asked me to take time away from my research to start your training.

Don't worry, I won't hold it against you.

The simplest of the summoning spells you will learn is that of the imp. Before I impart this to you, however, you must prove that you have the necessary magical and physical ability.

Bring me three feather charms from the frostmane novices from the cave to the southwest.
1599-accept.title: Beginnings

1618-accept.name: Tormus Deepforge
1618-accept.text:
We dwarves aren't the only ones fighting.  Our human allies have their hands full too!

Redridge is under periodic attack from blackrock orcs, and their supply of equipment is always low.  If you were to help them out, I'm sure their resident blacksmith, Verner Osgood, would teach you a trick or two.
1618-accept.title: Gearing Redridge

1645-complete.name: Tiza Battleforge
1645-complete.text:
A pleasure to meet you, $N. I am responsible for putting paladins on the path to greater virtue as they devote themselves to the Light and defend Azeroth from the Scourge and other threats.

The time has come for you to take your first step towards being truly virtuous. If you accept it, I will give you a Book of Divinity. In studying it, you shall learn some about the Light, and what is expected of you. If you understand it, and are capable, then you will succeed in attaining greater abilities.
1645-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1646-accept.name: Unknown
1646-accept.text:
In all things, a $c must reflect the Light which supplements our strength. To strive to be divine for one of our kind does not mean we strive for godhood--we strive to be good in all actions.

Although called upon to smite evil in these harsh times, you must always remember that it's aiding others that will truly set you apart from the citizens of Azeroth. Compassion, patience, bravery--these things mean as much to a $c as strength in battle.

Know this well, and never forget it.
1646-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1646-complete.name: Tiza Battleforge
1646-complete.text:
Welcome back, $N. You've spent time reading the book, I hope?

Then you should be prepared to have yourself tested. There are always tasks to be done throughout the city and our lands; acts of compassion and understanding; people who need help; creatures to slay.

By proving you have the patience to help others, especially those who are less fortunate, you prove that you are a servant of the Light and of sound mind.
1646-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1647-accept.name: Tiza Battleforge
1647-accept.text:
Your task then, $N, is to find someone here in Ironforge that is in need of aid. Someone who is pure of heart and motive. Perhaps someone helping others. Perhaps someone in need of a guide. Regardless, the person must have noble intent and be relying on your kindness.

Do this, and return to me when you are finished. Then, we shall discuss more of your path and what it means to be a $c of the Light. I will remain here in the temple for your return. Other paladins will need my guidance also.
1647-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1647-complete.name: John Turner
1647-complete.text:
THE ORPHANAGE OF STOR... oh, sorry, didn't mean to shout at you, sir,

My name is John Turner. How are you?

Good, good, glad to hear things go well for you. I've had a long day of work already, and I miss my wife terribly, but that's the price you have to pay when there are mouths to feed and backs to clothe.
1647-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1648-accept.name: John Turner
1648-accept.text:
My wife and I run an orphanage in Stormwind, mostly for children who have lost parents due to the attacks by the Scourge in the last decade. I come to Ironforge every month or so to see about collecting more supplies from the citizens here, and talk to the various groups to see if they can do anything to help.

This trip's been agonizingly slow, and not very productive.

If I could just get some more linen for my wife to make some clothes, I could finally send a shipment home.
1648-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1648-complete.name: John Turner
1648-complete.text:
This is so wonderful of you, $N. Thank you again.

You're a noble man for doing this for me. It's no wonder you've chosen to follow the Light. I wish there was some way I could repay you for all you've done... what's that? It's the least you could do? See? That's what I'm talking about, $N, noble to the end.

Be safe, and may the Light protect you in your travels.
1648-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1648-progress.name: John Turner
1648-progress.text:
What with the influx of tradesmen here and throughout Azeroth, there's a smaller supply of items we use to make clothes for the children of our orphanage. Helping me collect linen so my wife can make new clothes for them is very noble of you, $N. Thank you.

Hopefully, I'll be able to return home to my wife soon.
1648-progress.title: The Tome of Divinity

170-accept.name: Balir Frosthammer
170-accept.text:
I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.

I hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.

And that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! 

We're a bit shorthanded here, lad, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
170-accept.title: A New Threat

170-complete.name: Balir Frosthammer
170-complete.text: If the problems we've had here are indicative of what is happening elsewhere in our lands, by Magni's beard, we have some troubles ahead of us! I can only hope that the king and Senate are taking steps to deal with the threat the troggs pose.
170-complete.title: A New Threat

1778-accept.name: John Turner
1778-accept.text: I'm going to see about making plans to return home soon. Hopefully, Stephanie is doing well back in Stormwind. I can't wait to see her again. Till next we meet, $c.
1778-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1778-complete.name: Tiza Battleforge
1778-complete.text:
So, you've returned so quickly, huh? And what pray tell have you accomplished in your time away from here?

Were you able to help a noble cause? Perhaps you've learned the value of charity or some more about your obligations to the citizens of Azeroth. Tell me, who have you helped and how.... Impressive, $N, those are surely the actions of one who follows the Light.

Such sacrifice will always be rewarded in time.
1778-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1779-accept.name: Tiza Battleforge
1779-accept.text:
I want you to take this, $N. It is called the Symbol of Life.

You've proven charitable and patient, and now I want you to prove just how adept you've become in both combat, and power.

My husband Muiredon returned recently from an encounter with some Dark Iron dwarves, and he barely escaped with his life--he's over there having his wounds healed by one of our priests.

Take the Symbol and speak to him. If you can help him, then we will speak again soon. May the Light shine upon you.
1779-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1779-complete.name: Muiredon Battleforge
1779-complete.text:
*cough*

Good day to ya, $c. Don't mind me wounds, the good priest 'ere'll take care of ol' Muiredon in time. Not needin' the power of that Symbol of Life ya got there quite yet.

So, me wife sent ya o'er to speak to me, huh? Fair 'nough. I'll take the time to talk to ya--I'll tell ya exactly wut happened to Muiredon and his best friend Narm, a $c jus' like yerself.
1779-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1783-accept.name: Muiredon Battleforge
1783-accept.text:
We was spyin' on some of the Dark Iron dwarves that've bunkered down south of Helm's Bed Lake. We knew they was up to no good, so Narm an' me thought we'd take a closer look--got ta see their leader given orders to some o' his men.

Narm an' me took the chance to kill a few of 'em, but they proved tougher than we thought, an' more of 'em got the jump on us. Narm tol' me to run an' get support, so 'ere I am.

Narm needs help, an' I'll not rest till he gets it.

C'n ya help, $N?
1783-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1783-complete.name: Narm Faulk
1783-complete.text:
I can't thank you enough, brother.

I can only assume that Tiza and Muiredon sent you here to aid me if you carry the Symbol of Life.

It's true, I fell to the Dark Iron while trying to attain one of the scripts: I was able to hold on long enough to allow Muiredon to escape, but the Light had almost embraced me fully when you came along. The fact that you were powerful enough to use the Symbol means great things for you, but there's time to speak of that later.
1783-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1784-accept.name: Narm Faulk
1784-accept.text:
Before I fell in battle, Muiredon and I had almost defeated one of the Dark Iron spies near that small house. We witnessed their captain passing orders to them, and sought to kill him and take the orders.

Some of the council in Ironforge do not yet believe the presence of Dark Iron dwarves exists in Dun Morogh. By attaining one of those scripts, we'll not only have proof of their movements, but possibly an idea of what they're planning.

Get one of those scripts and take it back to Muiredon, $N.
1784-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1784-complete.name: Muiredon Battleforge
1784-complete.text:
Haha! You've done it! Ya saved Narm, and ya found the proof me wife needs to take to the council. Yer a blessin' o' the Light if I ever saw one... not includin' me wife o' course.

Thank ya again, $N.
1784-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

1784-progress.name: Muiredon Battleforge
1784-progress.text: Yer back! I'm glad to see it, $N. My wounds are healed and I'm about ready to return to Helm's Bed lake as soon as I c'n convince me wife that I'll be fine.
1784-progress.title: The Tome of Divinity

1785-accept.name: Muiredon Battleforge
1785-accept.text:
I c'n see me wife's o'er there beamin' wit pride already. Ya better get yer tuchus o'er there pronto. I be thinkin' she'd have some words wit ya.

Light be witcha, mighty $c. I'll be lookin' fer ya on the battlefield against the Scourge and dem Dark Irons when the time comes.
1785-accept.title: The Tome of Divinity

1785-complete.name: Tiza Battleforge
1785-complete.text:
You've done all of Ironforge a great favor today, $N. I'm proud to count you among us, and if you feel you're ready, I would like to bless you with this scroll. The Symbol of Life would only have worked when used by a $c who was ready for one of the Light's greatest blessings--the power to restore the dead back to life.

I will teach you the ability to resurrect your companions. Use it wisely, $N, and thank you, on behalf of myself, my husband, and Ironforge.
1785-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

179-complete.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-complete.text: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, $N, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.
179-complete.title: Dwarven Outfitters

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

182-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
182-accept.text:
My brother Senir and I were sent to different parts of Dun Morogh to investigate the threat posed by the trolls. The Senate has its hands full with the troggs, so they've no need for further annoyances.

From what I've seen, the trolls aren't well situated here in Coldridge Valley--mostly the southern cave. I'd say that the army will not be necessary. A few strong arms should be more than enough.

Perhaps you'd like to assist in this endeavor? I have the authority to offer compensation for your help.
182-accept.title: The Troll Cave

182-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
182-complete.text:
Argh! Those Light-blasted trolls!

<He takes a few breaths and seems to settle down... a bit.>

A group of them came in the night and stole my journal! I knew better than to trust that good-for-nothing appr...
182-complete.title: The Troll Cave

183-accept.name: Talin Keeneye
183-accept.text:
Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?

Though, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.

Long story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.
183-accept.title: The Boar Hunter

183-complete.name: Talin Keeneye
183-complete.text: Excellent! I can go back to my... leisurely... hunting now. Thank you, $N.
183-complete.title: The Boar Hunter

2039-accept.name: Gnoarn
2039-accept.text:
We've lost contact with Bingles! He was sent on a reconnaissance mission over Gnomeregan and hasn't reported back in over a week. I just know he's gone and blown himself up.

He was last seen flying over the Loch. Perhaps you can investigate, $N.
2039-accept.title: Find Bingles

2160-accept.name: Hands Springsprocket
2160-accept.text:
Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?

You were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.

Anyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!
2160-accept.title: Supplies to Tannok

2160-complete.name: Tannok Frosthammer
2160-complete.text:
Ah, at last, the supplies from Hands! I was beginning to worry, we've had scarce word from Anvilmar ever since the troggs overran the pass.

Thanks for bringing this to me, $N. And please, make yourself comfortable. You must be tired after your journey.
2160-complete.title: Supplies to Tannok

2160-progress.name: Tannok Frosthammer
2160-progress.text: Hi there! Come in, take a seat by the fire and warm yourself with a flagon of ale.
2160-progress.title: Supplies to Tannok

218-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
218-accept.text:
My journal! They took it away to the cave. The one that had it... It was a big brute with some odd markings on his skin and face. I didn't get a much better look than that.

You've had some luck with the trolls, maybe you could go get it back for me?
218-accept.title: The Stolen Journal

218-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
218-complete.text:
Wonderful, $N! Many thanks for retrieving my notebook. Well, it would seem that the troll situation here in Coldridge Valley is under control and not much cause for worry.

After I put the finishing touches on my report, I'll need someone to courier it to my brother Senir.
218-complete.title: The Stolen Journal

22-accept.name: Salma Saldean
22-accept.text: The onions are peeled.  The garlic is minced.  The rosemary is crushed.  The crust has been baked.  The dill weed is chopped.  The gravy is simmering.  Now all I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-accept.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

22-complete.name: Salma Saldean
22-complete.text: These are just perfect, $N!  Thank you so much.  Farmer Saldean and I are going to feast tonight.  And here is a little something for you, for the hard work.  You didn't think I was going to let a $c like you go hungry, did you?
22-complete.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

224-accept.name: Mountaineer Cobbleflint
224-accept.text:
We need to protect the Loch, $N!  With so many of the King's soldiers fighting valiantly on remote battlefields, we've become overwhelmed on the home front.  Troggs are tunneling up from every crevice!  The Trogg infestation poses the largest threat to Ironforge.  These disgusting mutants must be destroyed.

We need you, brave adventurer, to venture forth and lay waste to the Trogg threat.  Slay 10 Stonesplinter Troggs and 10 Stonesplinter Scouts and report back.
224-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

224-complete.name: Mountaineer Cobbleflint
224-complete.text:
Well done, $N!  You demonstrated uncanny courage on the battlefield.  Our war against the Troggs will be won with efforts such as yours.  You have served King Magni well.

If you fancy yourself well-suited for this kind of adventuring, I suggest you speak with Mountaineer Gravelgaw.  The Captain has him assigned to a rough patrol that I am sure he can use some help with.  Check with Gravelgaw just inside the tower.
224-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

233-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
233-accept.text:
Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, lad? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.

They're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.

What do you say?
233-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

233-complete.name: Talin Keeneye
233-complete.text:
Thank you, I've been waiting for these letters for quite some time...

Unfortunately, these letters aren't all for me. This one is addressed to Grelin Whitebeard. He's not too far away if you'd like to deliver it to him.
233-complete.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

233-progress.name: Talin Keeneye
233-progress.text: Yes? Do you have something for me?
233-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-accept.name: Talin Keeneye
234-accept.text: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.
234-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-complete.text: Ahh, excellent. It's been a while since I received word from Ironforge. Ach, these letters from me mum warm my heart. Here, not fair you don't get some readin', too. Take one of these manuals we have lyin' around.
234-complete.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-progress.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-progress.text: Is there something I can help you with?
234-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

237-accept.name: Mountaineer Gravelgaw
237-accept.text:
Mountaineer Cobbleflint had nothing but good things to say about you, $r.  For that reason I am going to entrust upon you a mission of utmost importance.  We need to keep pressure on the invading Trogg forces until our Dwarven brethren return from the Alliance front.

Set forth into the southern hills and kill 10 Stonesplinter Skullthumpers and 10 Stonesplinter Seers.  Your attacks will buy us some time.  Report back when your mission is complete.
237-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

255-accept.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
255-accept.text:
Two months just to hear from Ironforge that we'll be spared a handful of soldiers for our own defense, and another two months until they arrive! Bad enough that our town goes unprotected, but the excavation and the dam--the dam!--are open to attacks as well.

I've no choice then, it seems. I'll need hired arms.

How about you? You seem a likely sort, $c. A group of ogres has set up camp on the northeast of the lake. Perhaps you could recruit some others and help remove the threat to our town?
255-accept.title: Mercenaries

267-accept.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-accept.text:
$C, you may or may not be aware of the Trogg threat looming over Dwarven lands.  With the Ironforge Reserve called up to the Alliance Front, we are left with a fraction of the defense forces needed to keep these lands safe.  My regiment is assigned to watch over the Gate here and we cannot leave our post for fear of invasion.

But we need some pressure put on those damned Troggs lurking in the hills.  If you're up to the task, wage an assault on the Troggs.  Bring me back 8 Trogg Stone Teeth as proof.
267-accept.title: The Trogg Threat

267-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-complete.text: I am quite impressed, $N.  You have done the Dwarven race a great favor by defending our lands.  King Magni Bronzebeard himself would be proud!
267-complete.title: The Trogg Threat

267-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-progress.text: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $N.
267-progress.title: The Trogg Threat

282-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
282-accept.text:
I was planning on sending my apprentice to my brother Senir with my report, but I would feel much better were it placed in more... reliable hands. That is, of course, if you wouldn't mind?

Hmm... you'll have to take the tunnel to get to Kharanos.

Speak with Mountaineer Thalos before going through the tunnel. It's completely infested with troggs now.

Follow the road back to Anvilmar, then keep heading east to the tunnel, Thalos is stationed nearby.
282-accept.title: Senir's Observations

282-complete.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-complete.text:
Hm, well, if Whitebeard is sending you to Dun Morogh on important business, I can't very well stop you, can I?

At least let me provide you with some advice and directions.
282-complete.title: Senir's Observations

282-progress.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-progress.text:
Hail! Have a care, $N, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.

If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.
282-progress.title: Senir's Observations

287-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
287-accept.text:
I'm behind on my report, and could use your help, $N. I just managed to find where the trolls are holed up, but I saw so many trolls, I was afraid to go in.

Here's what I need... Go down to the cave, poke around inside, kill a few of the trolls, then come back here.

Take the road north out of Kharanos, when you get to the bridge, follow the frozen river west until you reach Iceflow Lake. You'll find Brewnall Village on the west bank. The Hold is southwest of the village.
287-accept.title: Frostmane Hold

287-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
287-complete.text:
Ah, $N! I didn't think you'd have much trouble finding the place, my directions are excellent, you know...

Let me just finish up my report then.

<He brings out some paper and scribbles on it momentarily.>

There! Well, haha, now this certainly is funny... I don't suppose, $N, that you would mind doing one last favor for me?
287-complete.title: Frostmane Hold

291-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
291-accept.text:
Excellent! Take my report to Senator Barin Redstone. He's a sour type, so don't let his less-than-sunny disposition get to you. He's in Ironforge, in the chamber where King Magni holds court.

Don't know the way to Ironforge? Take the road out of Kharanos north, cross the bridge, then follow the road east--there are large banners flanking the road--up the mountainside.

By the way, if you might avoid mentioning how you assisted me? Can't let them think I'm not working hard out here, you know?
291-accept.title: The Reports

291-complete.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-complete.text:
<He quickly peruses the report.>

Authority of the KING!? Has Magni taken complete leave of his senses! And that damnable Whitebeard... Taken matters into his own hands, has he? The Senate will not be pleased to hear about this, not one bit.

What, are you still here? Go, before I call the guards!
291-complete.title: The Reports

291-progress.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-progress.text: Hmm... it would seem that my guards are becoming less discriminatory with petitioners. Well, what do you want? Make it quick.
291-progress.title: The Reports

2999-accept.name: Brandur Ironhammer
2999-accept.text: Hello, $N. I know you're busy helping out the people of Dun Morogh, but when you have the time, you should go upstairs and speak to one of our most respected ilk: Tiza Battleforge. She's the one the younger paladins go to when it's time they learn more about the Light and what's expected of ya.
2999-accept.title: Tome of Divinity

2999-complete.name: Tiza Battleforge
2999-complete.text: Well met, $N. I hope the Light shows you the true path and keeps you safe from evil.
2999-complete.title: Tome of Divinity

307-accept.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-accept.text:
The Silver Stream Mine to the east ran dry long ago.  It was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot, but now Kobolds have moved in, putting their filthy paws on good, Dwarven tools!

We'll root out those vermin soon enough, but the League wants someone to get their gear out of the mine before we warriors tromp in there and break things.  It'll be a tough delve - you might want cohorts at your side.

The gear is stored in Miners' League Crates throughout the mine.  Good luck.
307-accept.title: Filthy Paws

307-complete.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-complete.text: Did you see a lot of Kobolds in there?  I can't wait for the order to clear them out of the mine.  The thought of their grimy hands clawing around our mine makes my stomach rumble!
307-complete.title: Filthy Paws

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

310-accept.name: Marleth Barleybrew
310-accept.text:
I have to admit, those Thunderbrews make some good drinks. But they need to learn that theirs isn't the only decent brew! Maybe you can help me teach them that lesson...

Here, take this barrel of Barleybrew Scalder. Sneak into the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos and switch it with one of their barrels of Thunder Ale. Then we'll see how their patrons like my brew over theirs!

And if the barrels are guarded, then you might have to distract the guard...
310-accept.title: Bitter Rivals

310-complete.name: Unknown
310-complete.text: You quickly place Marleth's barrel of Barleybrew Scalder among the Thunderbrew barrels.
310-complete.title: Bitter Rivals

310-progress.name: Unknown
310-progress.text: The date on this barrel shows that it'll soon be tapped.
310-progress.title: Bitter Rivals

3107-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
3107-accept.text: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the $c trainer Bromos. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
3107-accept.title: Consecrated Rune

3107-complete.name: Bromos Grummner
3107-complete.text:
The humans have taught us a great deal about the Holy Light and how important their order is to them... and to protecting all of Azeroth. We have a great respect for how it is steeped in tradition, and how just one figure, one sacrifice, can make the difference between pain and salvation.

The two of us are gonna be working together for a bit. Any time you think you're ready, come back to me and we'll see about getting you some training. Can't have you go out into the world unprepared, now, can we?
3107-complete.title: Consecrated Rune

3107-progress.name: Bromos Grummner
3107-progress.text:
So, you've made it! And not a second too soon. There's much to be done in Coldridge Valley and beyond. I'm gonna need your help as much as you're gonna need mine!

You're a Knight of the Silver Hand now, be ready to play the part.
3107-progress.title: Consecrated Rune

3108-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
3108-accept.text: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the $c trainer Thorgas. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
3108-accept.title: Etched Rune

3108-complete.name: Thorgas Grimson
3108-complete.text:
One thing you should always remember is that you gotta respect the world you're livin' in. The beasts that choose to fight along side you; the shine of your weapon; the weight of your ammo; the bite of a bitter wind; all these things you need to know intimately.

I'll do what I can to help you, but most of the work's up to you. Anytime you think you're ready, come back and talk to me. I'll train you when I can.
3108-complete.title: Etched Rune

3108-progress.name: Thorgas Grimson
3108-progress.text:
Ya made it! Good to hear! Betcha didn't have to track me to find the place either. Haha!

Our profession is pretty steeped in tradition, $N. Learning the ways of the land. Learning to track a bear through the mountains. Even just surviving on wits alone takes a great deal of courage and cunning. Think you're capable?
3108-progress.title: Etched Rune

311-accept.name: Unknown
311-accept.text: Having inserted a barrel of Marleth's Scalder in the Kharanos Distillery's cellar, you grab a barrel of Thunder Ale as proof of the deed...
311-accept.title: Return to Marleth

311-complete.name: Marleth Barleybrew
311-complete.text:
Not bad, $N! Did you have a hard time getting past their guard?

No matter--many thanks, and if you're ever in need of stout with a kick, don't forget the Barleybrews!
311-complete.title: Return to Marleth

3115-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
3115-accept.text:
While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the $c trainer Alamar. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

And watch yerself, $N, your kind ain't too trusted 'round these parts.
3115-accept.title: Tainted Memorandum

3115-complete.name: Alamar Grimm
3115-complete.text:
But none of that matters. What matters is that you've seen your own Holy Light! You know where power truly comes from. You realize that having our own allies is much more... prudent. Special allies. Allies that, no matter the task, will obey till their last breath.

And that's where I come in, $N. I can train you in the beginnings of those special powers. Seek me out often and I will do what I can to teach you more spells.
3115-complete.title: Tainted Memorandum

3115-progress.name: Alamar Grimm
3115-progress.text:
Wonderful! You got my memorandum obviously.

Ignore the fools around you, $N. The Holy Light?! The sword and shield?! These aren't paths for ones as open minded as us. Look at what "normal" magic did to our home. Coupled with  those damned tinkerers, our race almost became extinct. And now we have to rely on the dwarves-- they'd rather spend time allying with humans than help us rebuild our own home. We're like second-class citizens. Have you seen the way they look at us?
3115-progress.title: Tainted Memorandum

312-accept.name: Tundra MacGrann
312-accept.text:
I had a month's worth of dried meats salted and locked away for the cold season.  Kept it locked so the bears wouldn't get it!  But while I was off hunting deer, that beast, Old Icebeard, made off with the meat locker.  He won't be able to smash through that Thorium though.  But I'll starve if I can't get my meats back.

You seem a bit more stealthy than me.  Perhaps you can retrieve my stash?  I'll never make it in and out of that cave fast enough with this bum leg of mine.
312-accept.title: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash

313-accept.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-accept.text:
Driving a Siege Engine isn't for everyone.  It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both!  How about you?  How's your mettle?  Want to prove it to me?

Well...I'm looking to make my engine, Trollplow, a little more cozy.  How about you get me a heap of Wendigo Manes from the Grizzled Den, west of Kharanos.  Those manes would make a great rug for Trollplow's inside deck!
313-accept.title: The Grizzled Den

313-complete.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-complete.text: Ah yes, these manes will work great!  You show a lot of grit, $C - I wager we'll see great things from you.
313-complete.title: The Grizzled Den

313-progress.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-progress.text: Hey, $N.  Been to the Grizzled Den yet?  Those Wendigos can be fierce.
313-progress.title: The Grizzled Den

314-accept.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-accept.text:
We heard the cries in the middle of the night.  Then this morning, sure enough, the herd was missing two rams.  That dastardly beast known as Vagash has been preying on our livelihood.  With most of King Magni's army off in distant lands fighting with the Alliance, there is no one to keep Vagash at bay.

Perhaps you are brave enough to seek out the beast and slay him.  Bring me one of his fangs and I will reward you.  Vagash lurks just above the ranch here, but be warned, he is deadly.
314-accept.title: Protecting the Herd

314-complete.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-complete.text: Very well done!  Veron will be so happy when he hears the good news.  To kill Vagash is no easy task.  I imagine one day you'll be fighting alongside King Magni's men on the Alliance Front.
314-complete.title: Protecting the Herd

314-progress.name: Rudra Amberstill
314-progress.text: Vagash still terrorizes the herd!  Please help us by killing the wretched beast.
314-progress.title: Protecting the Herd

315-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-accept.text:
I'm on a quest, a quest to make the perfect stout.  I know I can do it -- brewing's in my blood.  I just need to find the right recipe...

The Frostmane trolls grow a plant, shimmerweed, high up in the hills to the east.  They use it in their strange, tribal rituals.  We dwarves haven't found much use for it, but it has a unique taste...and I want to experiment with it in my brews!

Get me some shimmerweed from Frostmane seers, or swipe it from the trolls' shimmerweed baskets.
315-accept.title: The Perfect Stout

315-complete.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-complete.text: Great!  I can't wait to use these in some of my recipes.  There's one in particular I think it'll work great in...
315-complete.title: The Perfect Stout

315-progress.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-progress.text: Do you have that shimmerweed?  I almost have a batch of stout ready to brew, and I want to try throwing the weed in with this mixture.
315-progress.title: The Perfect Stout

317-accept.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
317-accept.text:
I'm preparing to start a mission for the Siege Brigade.  It's a long one, and I need to stock Jetsteam with a month's worth of supplies.  So while Steelgrill is working on my tank, can you do some hunting for me?

I'll need some fur for bedding, and boar meat for food.  You can get meat from boars and fur from the bears... you can find them both in the snow fields south of the Grizzled Den.
317-accept.title: Stocking Jetsteam

317-complete.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
317-complete.text: By Magni's beard, you sure did a lot of hunting!!  Thank you, $N.
317-complete.title: Stocking Jetsteam

317-progress.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
317-progress.text: Preparations are going well.  How goes your hunting?
317-progress.title: Stocking Jetsteam

318-accept.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
318-accept.text:
Rejold Barleybrew experiments with his brews.  Some of them taste good, some bad, and some...well, some will lay all but the stoutest $r flat.

He lives at Brewnall Village, west of Kharanos, and one of his drinks, Evershine, is what I want.  It'll help keep me warm while I'm on the cold road.

And...the blessed stuff burns so hot I can throw it in Jetsteam's furnace for a burst of power!  That little tactic has gotten me out of more than one tight spot.
318-accept.title: Evershine

318-complete.name: Rejold Barleybrew
318-complete.text: Bellowfiz needs some of my Evershine?  Hm...all right.
318-complete.title: Evershine

319-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
319-accept.text:
I have a cask of Evershine handy, but...can you do me a favor?  Brewnall village could use a hand against the wild animals that wander the nearby snows.  Sometimes they wander close.

We're not afraid of these bears and cats and boars - no self respecting $r would be - but if you can take care of those animals for us, then we'd have more time for our crafting and brewing.
319-accept.title: A Favor for Evershine

319-complete.name: Rejold Barleybrew
319-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  It'll be nice to work our crafts without hearing so many growls and snorts outside the village.
319-complete.title: A Favor for Evershine

320-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
320-accept.text: Here's your cask of Evershine, $N.  And again, thank you for the hunting earlier.
320-accept.title: Return to Bellowfiz

320-complete.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
320-complete.text: Yes, this will do just fine.  I think I'll open a bottle right now and have a taste...
320-complete.title: Return to Bellowfiz

3361-accept.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-accept.text:
We drove the troggs out of Gnomeregan, but then it all went so horribly wrong!  Now our home is completely irradiated, and we gnomes have been scattered all over Dun Morogh.

In my haste to get away from the radiation, I lost all my personal belongings and tools.  It was the trolls that got them.  They stole my chest, my box, and my bucket of bolts!  They took them back to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.

I'm no adventurer - could you find my things and bring them here to me, please?
3361-accept.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3361-complete.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-complete.text: Huzzah, you've found them!  You're an absolute savior, my friend.  Here, it's not much, but it's something for the trouble I've put you through!  Thank you!
3361-complete.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3361-progress.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-progress.text:
Oh goodness $N, this town is not well suited for the likes of me.  There are as many nasty creatures here as there were in Gnomeregan before the accident!

Do you have my belongings?  If you don't, then who knows what the trolls have done with them now...
3361-progress.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3364-accept.name: Nori Pridedrift
3364-accept.text:
Gah!  I was supposed to get this delicious scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar a while ago now, but I had to deliver one to Grelin here first.  I'll never make it to Anvilmar before the brew runs cold!

You look fast.  Maybe you can make it.  This cup will only stay hot for five more minutes, and Durnan didn't order "chilly" mornbrew, so get going.  Anvilmar is to the northeast, a settlement dug into the mountain.

Thanks, $N, and don't forget to bring me back my mug!
3364-accept.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3364-complete.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-complete.text: Ah good, now this will hit the spot.  Allow me to take a small break while I enjoy this scalding mornbrew!
3364-complete.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3364-progress.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-progress.text: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter.  You have something for me?
3364-progress.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3365-accept.name: Durnan Furcutter
3365-accept.text:
Now that hit the spot!  Nothing like a piping hot - nay, SCALDING mornbrew on a cold winter's day to warm your cackles of yer soul.

Here ya go $N - be a pal and take this empty mug back to Nori for me, would ya now.
3365-accept.title: Bring Back the Mug

3365-complete.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-complete.text:
Excellent, $N!  You'd be surprised how many couriers I meet who forget to do something as simple as bring back the mug.  Mugs don't grow on trees, or so they tell me!

Here's a little something for the effort.  Thanks again for your help.
3365-complete.title: Bring Back the Mug

3365-progress.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-progress.text: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time!  Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
3365-progress.title: Bring Back the Mug

353-accept.name: Grimand Elmore
353-accept.text:
The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes.  So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of Ironforge, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.

The weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant Loch Modan.  If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?

My last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan.
353-accept.title: Stormpike's Delivery

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

36-accept.name: Verna Furlbrow
36-accept.text:
I never thought the day would come when I'd leave the farm.  But the fields are overrun with thieves and it's far too dangerous for us here now.  As soon as Farmer Furlbrow gets the wagon fixed, we'll be on our way.  
 
Maybe you could do me a favor?  Let me scribble down my recipe for Westfall stew.  Please take it to Salma Saldean over on the farm yonder.  The Saldean's farm is just beyond the fork in the road.
36-accept.title: Westfall Stew

36-complete.name: Salma Saldean
36-complete.text: That Verna was always such a sweet lass.  We'll miss her here in Westfall but between you and me, she's a city girl at heart and Stormwind will suit her just fine.  But enough gossip!  Now we can make Westfall Stew!
36-complete.title: Westfall Stew

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

38-accept.name: Salma Saldean
38-accept.text:
Help me make some Westfall Stew!  Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-accept.title: Westfall Stew

38-progress.name: Salma Saldean
38-progress.text:
Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-progress.title: Westfall Stew

384-accept.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-accept.text:
Nothing my tavern patrons enjoy more than some Beer Basted Boar Ribs!  Only problem is, the local trapper who used to bring me supplies enlisted in the King's Army to help with the war on the Alliance front. 

Maybe you can help me out?  If you bring me six crag boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from the tavern here, I'll give you the family recipe for my famous Beer Basted Boar Ribs, not to mention a free sample!  The secret's in the Malt!
384-accept.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

384-complete.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-complete.text:
The Malt is brewed, the Boars are dead
And before all is done and anything said
We will have to fight for first dibs
On these savory Beer Basted Boar Ribs!
384-complete.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

384-progress.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-progress.text: I'm going to need six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt, $N.
384-progress.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

399-accept.name: Baros Alexston
399-accept.text:
It seems an eternity since I was a boy working the farm in Westfall. They say you can never go back, and it's true. Doubly true in my case, my family's home has been burned down and taken over by thieves.

I have spoken with my father about the fate of some of my possessions, including my first compass. He was unable to save them. However, he also says that they should be hidden away on the farm.

You'll find the Alexston Farmstead west of Sentinel Hill. Perhaps you could go and retrieve it for me?
399-accept.title: Humble Beginnings

399-complete.name: Baros Alexston
399-complete.text: Oh, thank you, $N! It's of no practical use to me, but the sentimental value... Needless to say, thank you for bringing this to me... at some cost to your own well-being, not to mention the time it took to go all the way down to Westfall. You have my gratitude, and have this as a token of my thanks.
399-complete.title: Humble Beginnings

400-accept.name: Tharek Blackstone
400-accept.text:
Beldin Steelgrill owns the local mechanic shop, and he's the best siege engine tech there is!  But he's not forgiving to his tools.  I swear he almost breaks more arclight spanners than we can supply him with!

We just filled his last order for tools.  If you deliver it to him I'm sure he'll make it worth the effort.

His shop, Steelgrill's Depot, is just northeast of Kharanos.  And it's a local haunt for veteran siege engine pilots, so keep your ears open for opportunities while you're there.
400-accept.title: Tools for Steelgrill

400-complete.name: Beldin Steelgrill
400-complete.text:
You have my tools?  Well done, lad, well done!  I just broke my last fang-ratchet an hour ago and I need one of those to finish repairs on Pilot Stonegear's siege engine.  You did a good thing by lugging those tools here, $N.

Here, take these coins for your help.
400-complete.title: Tools for Steelgrill

400-progress.name: Beldin Steelgrill
400-progress.text:
Hm?  You look a little young to be a siege engine pilot.  But no matter...do you need something fixed?

Well take a number and get comfortable.  I'm working on a couple engines right now and won't have time for another job for at least a few days.

Or, were you here for something else...?
400-progress.title: Tools for Steelgrill

412-accept.name: Razzle Sprysprocket
412-accept.text:
Upon further analysis of the Gnomeregan situation, it would appear as though we not only failed to eradicate the troggs but we also happened to turn most of the gnomish race into horrific, mindless, evil-doing leper gnomes.

Ozzie and I plan to reverse the horrible leper effect with our latest invention: The Recombobulator.  The machine is almost complete but we are in dire need of some Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears.  Retrieve some from the leper gnomes out front of Gnomeregan for us.
412-accept.title: Operation Recombobulation

412-complete.name: Razzle Sprysprocket
412-complete.text: These Gyromechanic Gears and Restabilization Cogs are in perfect accordance with Ozzie's schematics for the Recombobulation Device.  Once I add some hydrolubricant to the inner combustion pistons, adjust the crank-o-ratchet and increase of the viscosity of the electrogum gel, the gnomish race will be as good as new.
412-complete.title: Operation Recombobulation

412-progress.name: Razzle Sprysprocket
412-progress.text: The Recombobulator will be up and running as soon as we have sufficient Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears.
412-progress.title: Operation Recombobulation

413-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
413-accept.text:
I'd like my brother Wellart to try my new Shimmer Stout.  He's a Mountaineer stationed in the southern guard tower, one of two towers on the border to Loch Modan.

He may not be a brewer like the rest of us Barleybrews, but he loves his drinks and I know he'll like this one.

Can you bring him this Barrel of Shimmer Stout for me?
413-accept.title: Shimmer Stout

413-complete.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
413-complete.text:
<Mountaineer Barleybrew tastes the Shimmer Stout...>

Oh.  Whoa!  This stuff really puts a shine in your eyes.  I feel like I can see in the dark!
413-complete.title: Shimmer Stout

413-progress.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
413-progress.text:
Hello, $C!  And what business takes you all the way out here?

Something exciting, I hope.  I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...
413-progress.title: Shimmer Stout

414-accept.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
414-accept.text:
I've been drinking more of that Shimmer Stout my brother made - it's great stuff!  I want a fellow Mountaineer to try it.  His name's Kadrell, and he's usually patrolling the road through Thelsamar in Loch Modan.

To get to Thelsamar, go southeast through the tunnel, then turn northeast when the path forks into a road.  Follow that road straight into Thelsamar.

Give Mountaineer Kadrell this cask of Shimmer Stout and see what he thinks!
414-accept.title: Stout to Kadrell

414-complete.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
414-complete.text:
Now, let me have a taste...

Magni's Beard!  This stuff gets your head turning!  And it lightens the limbs, too.

I feel like I can fly!
414-complete.title: Stout to Kadrell

416-accept.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-accept.text:
We have a real infestation problem to the west.  Tunnel rat kobolds have moved into the foothills, setting up dens and fouling our land with their filth!

We want them eliminated.  Hunt them, bring me their ears and earn their bounty.

You can find tunnel rat kobolds and their dens west of Thelsamar, littered along the mountainside.
416-accept.title: Rat Catching

416-complete.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-complete.text:
Ugh!  When I asked for those ears I didn't realize they'd smell so bad!

Here's your reward, $N.  Well done.
416-complete.title: Rat Catching

416-progress.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-progress.text: Hail, $N.  How goes the rat catching?
416-progress.title: Rat Catching

418-accept.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-accept.text:
There's never a shortage of empty bellies here in Thelsamar, kids running in and out, workers from the excavation coming in after  a hard day's work. We're famous for our blood sausages, I don't suppose you've ever tried them?

No? Well, around here you've got to work for your meals, and don't think just because you're a fancy $c, you'll be any exception.

I'll need bear meat, boar intestines for the casings, and spider ichor for spice. You get me some of those, and leave the cooking to Vidra!
418-accept.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

418-complete.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-complete.text:
Trust me, it seems a lot harder than it looks, but...

Oh, I've never known someone to take much interest in the making of sausages, but I'll give you the recipe just in case. Here you go, mind you eat them fresh!
418-complete.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

420-accept.name: Mountaineer Thalos
420-accept.text:
The troggs in the tunnel are extremely hostile, and haven't shown any hesitation in attacking travelers through the tunnel. You seem tough enough, though, so you should probably be safe.

Directions? If you're going to speak with Senir, you'll find him in Kharanos.

Make your way through the tunnel, and after you come out on the other side, just keep following the road, it'll run right into Kharanos.
420-accept.title: Senir's Observations

420-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-complete.text:
What's this? Ah, my brother's report. Hmm...

I told him to be sparing with the use of the King's name, but he didn't listen. No harm, I suppose, though it's sure to ruffle some feathers in the Senate. Not that those weren't some feathers that needed ruffling! Hah!

Nonetheless, I guess that means that I should send my report on to Ironforge as well, but I must admit I'm a bit behind. Bloody cold.

I should have some work for you later, if you're interested.
420-complete.title: Senir's Observations

420-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-progress.text: How are you? Like to share a drink with me, perhaps? Not much else to do in the cold.
420-progress.title: Senir's Observations

432-accept.name: Foreman Stonebrow
432-accept.text:
Those Light-blasted troggs, turning my work site into a wreck! Look at that, there goes another barrel of powder!

Ohhh, I wish I could go down there and wring every one of their scrawny little necks! I want to kill them all!

This can't be good for my health, all this stress and anger... What have they left me with? Nothing!

I'd kill them myself, but my aim's no good anymore! You go into the quarry and kill some of the filthy buggers! I'll pay you! Just hurt them, kill them!
432-accept.title: Those Blasted Troggs!

432-complete.name: Foreman Stonebrow
432-complete.text:
Well, that makes me feel a little better...

But I won't be happy until they're all dead! All of them!
432-complete.title: Those Blasted Troggs!

433-accept.name: Senator Mehr Stonehallow
433-accept.text:
As a member of the Senate and the Explorers' League, I've taken it upon myself to take care of this part of the trogg infestation that has gripped our lands.

They've certainly made a mess of Gol'Bolar quarry, and for no reason. As we dug deep into the earth, they poured out, destroying our equipment and driving the miners out. There's not much for us to do but to exterminate the lot of them, rebuild, then get back to work.

If you help me with the troggs, I'll gladly recompense you for your time.
433-accept.title: The Public Servant

433-complete.name: Senator Mehr Stonehallow
433-complete.text:
It is a start. Hopefully we can take advantage of it, and move some Mountaineers in to secure the area. Then we can begin to restore our infrastructure and get the miners back to work.

Thank you for your assistance, $N.
433-complete.title: The Public Servant

436-accept.name: Jern Hornhelm
436-accept.text:
Prospector Ironband is heading an excavation of ancient ruins east of the lake.  His progress has been slow lately, especially considering all the supplies we've sent him.

Ironband's a stout, honest $r who values results, which has me worried that forces are at work against him.

Go to Ironband's Excavation and speak with Magmar Fellhew.  He manages the details of the site and will know why there's a slowdown.

To get to the excavation site, go around the southern tip of the lake, then head east.
436-accept.title: Ironband's Excavation

5541-accept.name: Loslor Rudge
5541-accept.text:
Hegnar Rumbleshot sells guns off the road to Anvilmar.  Riflemen and mortar teams spend a lot of time practicing out near his shop, and he's always needing fresh ammunition.

But... the last crate of ammo I sent him got lost along the way.  My courier said he was camped near the Grizzled Den when wendigo chased him away... and the fool left Rumbleshot's ammo behind!

$N, can you get that ammo and take it to Rumbleshot?  He's been waiting on it and I'm sure he's running low.
5541-accept.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

5541-complete.name: Hegnar Rumbleshot
5541-complete.text:
Great, more ammo!  Old Loslor's shipment finally came through!  The ammo might be late, but just like my grand daddy used to tell me: late's better than never!

Thank you much, $N.  I already have buyers eager for this stuff!
5541-complete.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

5541-progress.name: Hegnar Rumbleshot
5541-progress.text: I hope you're not here for ammo, because I'm almost out!
5541-progress.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

62-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
62-accept.text:
The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems!  I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.

Explore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me.  The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
62-accept.title: The Fargodeep Mine

6387-accept.name: Brock Stoneseeker
6387-accept.text:
I see a lot of young dwarves at my door, eager to learn the trade of mining.  And if there's one thing a miner needs more than anything, it's a pick!

I have a list of mining students who scored high in their lessons and earned an honorary pick.  Take my list to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.  He'll get the picks ready.

The fastest way to Ironforge is on a gryphon, so bring the list to our gryphon master, Thorgrum Borrelson, and speak with him about transport to Ironforge.
6387-accept.title: Honor Students

6387-complete.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
6387-complete.text: You have to get this to Ironforge, eh?  For a small fee I can put you on the back of one of my gryphons, and it'll take you there.  How does that sound?
6387-complete.title: Honor Students

6387-progress.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
6387-progress.text: Have you had your fill of Thelsamar so soon?  Are you ready to leave for another city?
6387-progress.title: Honor Students

6388-accept.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6388-accept.text:
Here are the honorary picks for Brock's students.  If you've already been to Thelsamar, then you should fly a gryphon back there!

Take the picks to our gryphon master, Gryth Thurden, and speak with him about a ride back to Thelsamar.
6388-accept.title: Gryth Thurden

6388-complete.name: Gryth Thurden
6388-complete.text: You have to get these to Thelsamar, eh?  That won't be a problem.  As long as you've already been to Thelsamar and spoken to Thorgrum Borrelson, then you can take one of my gryphons back to him.
6388-complete.title: Gryth Thurden

6388-progress.name: Gryth Thurden
6388-progress.text: You look like you have somewhere to go.  Need one of my gryphons?
6388-progress.title: Gryth Thurden

6391-accept.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
6391-accept.text:
For just a few coins, one of my gryphons will take you to Ironforge.  From there, deliver Brock's list to Golnir Bouldertoe.  You'll find him in the Deep Mountain Mining Guild.  That's in the Great Forge District of Ironforge, which is right where my gryphon will drop you off!

Speak to me again when you're ready for the journey.
6391-accept.title: Ride to Ironforge

6391-complete.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6391-complete.text: Ah, the lastest list of Brock's best pupils.  I have a batch of honorary picks ready to go.  I just need to chisel in the names of the students...
6391-complete.title: Ride to Ironforge

6391-progress.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6391-progress.text: What can I do for you, sir?
6391-progress.title: Ride to Ironforge

6392-accept.name: Gryth Thurden
6392-accept.text:
For a small fee you can buy a gryphon ride to Thelsamar... as long as you've already been there.  Gryphons will only fly you to places you've already been, so be sure to speak with every gryphon master you see so you can fly to him later.

You've already been to Thorgrum, the gryphon master of Thelsamar, so now you can return to him.  And once in Thelsamar, you can deliver the picks to Brock Stoneseeker.

Speak with me when you're ready to go.
6392-accept.title: Return to Brock

6392-complete.name: Brock Stoneseeker
6392-complete.text:
You brought the picks.  Great!  I'll get these to my mining students.  I'm sure they're eager to use them on the ore deposits of Loch Modan.

Thank you for your help, $N.  I am in your debt, but I hope this money will at least cover your travel costs.
6392-complete.title: Return to Brock

6392-progress.name: Brock Stoneseeker
6392-progress.text: Ah, $N.  Have you returned from Ironforge?
6392-progress.title: Return to Brock

64-accept.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-accept.text: It was horrible!  Verna woke me when she heard a ruckus in the fields.  The fields were full of hooligans.  We left in a rush and I forgot to pack my pocket watch.  Verna's pa gave me that watch on our wedding day and I feel just sick knowing those thieves have it.  I left the pocket watch in the wardrobe at the farmhouse.  Look for the field of pumpkins to the West -- you can't miss it.  If you bring it back to me, I'd sure be grateful!
64-accept.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

64-complete.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-complete.text:
My watch!  Thank you so much, kind sir! 

We are but poor farmers and we have lost our land but please accept this reward as a token of our appreciation.
64-complete.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

65-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
65-accept.text:
The band of wretches responsible for driving the good people of Westfall from the land call themselves The Defias Brotherhood.  I need you to infiltrate this clan of thugs.  We need to know who heads up the cartel and where they are hiding out.  In Lakeshire, in the inn, there is a rogue by the name of Wiley who owes me a favor.

Travel to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, east of Elwynn, and find out what you can.
65-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

86667-accept.name: Grenhild Darktalon
86667-accept.text:
My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.
86667-accept.title: Snowbound

86667-complete.name: Norric Lochthane
86667-complete.text:
This jar is for me?

Snow! Grenhild did it! She sent the snow that I asked for!

A pity, though, I was hoping she would come and visit in person.

Well, regardless, thank you for your effort. This is a real help for my work.
86667-complete.title: Snowbound

9-accept.name: Farmer Saldean
9-accept.text:
Look at what has happened to this place!  These lands were once occupied by good farm folk.  But the damned thieves have driven them all off.  Not me, though!  But it seems some Harvest Watchers have taken over the fields.

If you're up for the work, I'd like you to go out and kill twenty of them.  Come back when you're done for your pay.  If you finish up with the ones in my field, clear them from the neighboring fields as well.
9-accept.title: The Killing Fields

9-complete.name: Farmer Saldean
9-complete.text: Good work, friend.  You have earned your pay well.  Who knows, perhaps Westfall will prosper once again.
9-complete.title: The Killing Fields

92742-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92742-accept.text:
We must determine the source and nature of the poison corrupting this land. Let us begin with the groundwater under the farms in the area.

Go to the Jansen Stead in the north and the Molsen Farm northwest of here, and collect samples from the wells there.
92742-accept.title: Testing the Wells

92744-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-accept.text:
The corruption affecting Westfall's crops may have seeped into the ocean as well. If the local fish are affected too, it could doom Stormwind to famine.
Collect gills from the murlocs along the shoreline and bring them to me. Murlocs are quite hardy, but their physiology is extremely sensitive to contaminants. Any toxins in the seawater will be readily apparent in the gills you find.
92744-accept.title: Murloc Gills

92744-complete.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-complete.text: I see... these gills appear to be healthy, for now. But we must not be complacent.
92744-complete.title: Murloc Gills

92744-progress.name: Alba Fairmoon
92744-progress.text: I hope the murlocs did not give you too much trouble?
92744-progress.title: Murloc Gills

92745-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92745-accept.text:
The well samples you collected contain toxic metals! If we do not put an end to this corruption quickly, it will be decades before crops can grow in this soil again.
The Defias have seized the mines of Westfall and use creatures as labor to strip their resources. Disrupt them by slaying their miners in the Jangolode Mine to the north, and the Gold Coast Quarry to the west.
92745-accept.title: The State of the Mines

92909-accept.name: Ozwin Ironsprocket
92909-accept.text:
Oh no... I'm in for it now!

I heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable!

If I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?
92909-accept.title: Harvesting the Harvesters

95041-accept.name: Jemma Quikswitch
95041-accept.text:
Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.

It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.
